from scipy.ndimage import gaussian_filter1d
import artifact_io

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
W,H = 3840,2160
cv2.setNumThreads(6)

FRONT = np.array([[1696.,756.],[2749.,705.],[2887.,1637.],[1848.,1917.]],np.float32)
BACK = np.array([[1696.,756.],[2749.,705.],[2374.247,1462.835],[1515.,1638.]],np.float32)

def poly_mask(points, shape=(H,W), blur=0):
    m=np.zeros(shape,np.uint8)
    cv2.fillPoly(m,[np.round(points).astype(np.int32)],255,lineType=cv2.LINE_AA)
    if blur: m=cv2.GaussianBlur(m,(0,0),blur)
    return m

# The measured camera transform exactly reprojects the five visible card corners.
rotvec=np.array([1.63724389,-.436691433,.308821275])
R=cv2.Rodrigues(rotvec)[0]
t=np.array([.659021902,1.04454086,4.35192328])
d,height,focal,db=.285123515,1.61775204,2620.14811,1.17685905
vertices=np.array([[-1,0,height],[1,0,height],[1,-d,0],[-1,-d,0],[-1,db,0],[1,db,0]])
pivot=np.array([-.03,.2,0])

def project(points):
    q=np.asarray(points)@R.T+t
    return q[:,:2]/q[:,2,None]*focal+[1920,1080]

def card_points(angle):
    a=-np.deg2rad(angle)
    rz=np.array([[np.cos(a),-np.sin(a),0],[np.sin(a),np.cos(a),0],[0,0,1]])
    pp=(vertices-pivot)@rz.T+pivot
    xy=project(pp)
    # Preserve native corner coordinates instead of losing subpixel precision.
    initial=project(vertices)
    anchors=np.vstack([FRONT[:2],FRONT[2:],BACK[3],BACK[2]])
    xy+=anchors-initial
    return xy,pp

            else:b[k]+=small[ny,nx]

A=sparse.csr_matrix((V,(I,J)),shape=(len(rr),len(rr)))
for c in range(3):small[rr,cc,c]=spsolve(A,b[:,c])
filled=cv2.resize(small.astype(np.float32),(W,H),interpolation=cv2.INTER_CUBIC)

wallgrain=F.astype(np.float32)-cv2.GaussianBlur(F.astype(np.float32),(0,0),2)
warpedgrain=np.roll(wallgrain,(420,830),(0,1))

wallblend=cv2.GaussianBlur(wallmissing.astype(np.float32),(0,0),4)

mapx=(X-1420).astype(np.float32)
mapy=(Y+124.82).astype(np.float32)
wood=cv2.remap(F,mapx,mapy,cv2.INTER_LINEAR,borderMode=cv2.BORDER_REFLECT_101)

ex=(X-2221.3)/520.8
ey=(Y-1672.8)/224.7
inside_top=(ex*ex+ey*ey)<=1
root=np.sqrt(np.maximum(0,1-ex*ex))
frontedge=1672.8+224.7*root
bottomedge=1936+224.7*root
inside_side=(np.abs(ex)<1)&(Y>=frontedge)&(Y<=bottomedge)
basegrain=F[1940:2120,1950:2550].astype(np.float32)
basegrain-=cv2.GaussianBlur(basegrain,(0,0),5)
grain=basegrain[(Y%180),(X%600)]

for c,base in enumerate([32,29,30]):base_top[:,:,c]=base+19*ex+2*ey+grain[:,:,c]*.4

for c,base in enumerate([11,7,7]):sidecol[:,:,c]=base+2*np.cos(ex*2.2)+grain[:,:,c]*.28+rim*11

tablemissing=(removal>0)&(~wall)
tableblend=cv2.GaussianBlur(tablemissing.astype(np.float32),(0,0),4)

# Procedural felt ball: diffuse sphere, fiber noise and a continuous curved seam.
def make_ball(size=512):
    yy,xx=np.mgrid[:size,:size]
    u=(xx-(size-1)/2)/((size-6)/2);v=(yy-(size-1)/2)/((size-6)/2)
    r2=u*u+v*v
    z=np.sqrt(np.maximum(0,1-r2))
    a=np.clip((1-np.sqrt(r2))*(size-6)/2+1,0,1)
    light=np.array([-.44,-.61,.66]);light/=np.linalg.norm(light)
    diffuse=np.maximum(0,u*light[0]+v*light[1]+z*light[2])
    illumination=.39+.68*diffuse
    rng=np.random.default_rng(43)
    fibers=rng.normal(0,1,(size,size))
    fine=cv2.GaussianBlur(fibers.astype(np.float32),(0,0),.45)
    rough=cv2.GaussianBlur(fibers.astype(np.float32),(0,0),2.7)
    col=np.zeros((size,size,3),np.float32)
    for c,base in enumerate([219,114,30]):
        col[:,:,c]=base*illumination+fine*(2.7 if c<2 else 1.8)+rough*4
    # Seam mapped onto a wavy spherical equator, viewed obliquely.
    theta=np.linspace(0,2*np.pi,2800)
    lat=.62*np.sin(2*theta)
    pts=np.stack([np.cos(theta)*np.cos(lat),np.sin(theta)*np.cos(lat),np.sin(lat)],1)
    rr1=cv2.Rodrigues(np.array([.94,.78,-.45]))[0]
    pts=pts@rr1.T
    seam=np.zeros((size,size),np.uint8)
    for k in range(len(pts)-1):
        if pts[k,2]>.005 and pts[k+1,2]>.005:
            p1=np.round(pts[k,:2]*(size-6)/2+(size-1)/2).astype(int)
            p2=np.round(pts[k+1,:2]*(size-6)/2+(size-1)/2).astype(int)
            cv2.line(seam,tuple(p1),tuple(p2),255,4,cv2.LINE_AA)
    seam=cv2.GaussianBlur(seam.astype(np.float32)/255,(0,0),.65)
    border=cv2.GaussianBlur(seam,(0,0),1.6)
    col*=1-.15*border[:,:,None]
    seamcol=np.stack([198*illumination,184*illumination,136*illumination],2)
    col=col*(1-seam[:,:,None])+seamcol*seam[:,:,None]
    col=np.clip(col,0,255)
    return np.dstack([col*a[:,:,None],a]).astype(np.float32)
balltex=make_ball()


def composite_warp(frame, tex, M, bounds, shading=1):
    bx0,by0,bx1,by1=bounds
    bx0=max(0,int(np.floor(bx0))-3);by0=max(0,int(np.floor(by0))-3)
    bx1=min(W,int(np.ceil(bx1))+3);by1=min(H,int(np.ceil(by1))+3)
    if bx0>=bx1 or by0>=by1:return
    shift=np.array([[1,0,-bx0],[0,1,-by0],[0,0,1]],np.float64)
    warped=cv2.warpPerspective(tex,shift@M,(bx1-bx0,by1-by0),flags=cv2.INTER_LINEAR,borderMode=cv2.BORDER_CONSTANT)
    aa=warped[:,:,3:4]
    frame[by0:by1,bx0:bx1]=np.clip(frame[by0:by1,bx0:bx1]*(1-aa)+warped[:,:,:3]*shading,0,255).astype(np.uint8)


def smooth(q):
    q=np.clip(q,0,1);return q*q*(3-2*q)

def keyinterp(tt,keys):
    if tt<=keys[0][0]:return np.array(keys[0][1:],float)
    if tt>=keys[-1][0]:return np.array(keys[-1][1:],float)
    for i in range(len(keys)-1):
        a,b=keys[i],keys[i+1]
        if a[0]<=tt<=b[0]:
            q=smooth((tt-a[0])/(b[0]-a[0]));return np.array(a[1:])*(1-q)+np.array(b[1:])*q

def draw_shadow(frame,cx,cy,rx,ry,opacity):
    x0=max(0,int(cx-rx*2));x1=min(W,int(cx+rx*2));y0=max(0,int(cy-ry*3));y1=min(H,int(cy+ry*3))

def render(index):

    rad=190*bs
    if tt>2.1:

        draw_shadow(img,2853,1494,182,32,.27*closeness)
        draw_shadow(img,2853,1492,115,10,.26*closeness)
    # A soft rotating footprint shadow on the turntable, following the paper.
    footprint=xy[[2,3,4,5]]
    shad=poly_mask(footprint,(H,W)).astype(np.float32)/255
    shad=cv2.GaussianBlur(shad,(0,0),13)
    # Shadows only affect the substrate; subsequent surfaces occlude them.
    img=(img*(1-.11*shad[:,:,None])).astype(np.uint8)
    # The ball is beneath/inside the open jaws and behind both sheets.
    sz=balltex.shape[0]
    B=np.array([[rad*2/sz,0,bx-rad],[0,rad*2/sz,by-rad],[0,0,1]],float)
    composite_warp(img,balltex,B,(bx-rad,by-rad,bx+rad,by+rad))
    # Pole length naturally extends above the frame while the jaws translate.
    # Pivot is the original hidden ball center, retaining the photograph's geometry.
    A=np.array([[sc,0,tx-sc*1758+sc*1430],[0,sc,ty-sc*1170],[0,0,1]],float)
    toolbounds=(tx+sc*(1430-1758),ty-sc*1170,tx+sc*(2090-1758),ty+sc*(1390-1170))
    if released:
        opening=14*smooth((tt-3.18)/.27)
        AR=A.copy();AR[0,2]+=opening
        AL=A.copy();AL[0,2]-=opening*.6
        composite_warp(img,right,AR,(toolbounds[0],toolbounds[1],toolbounds[2]+opening,toolbounds[3]))
        composite_warp(img,rgba,AL,(toolbounds[0]-opening,toolbounds[1],toolbounds[2],toolbounds[3]))
    else:
        composite_warp(img,right,A,toolbounds)
        composite_warp(img,rgba,A,toolbounds)
    # Far sheet followed by the near sheet, in camera depth order.
    backquad=xy[[0,1,5,4]].astype(np.float32)
    frontquad=xy[[0,1,2,3]].astype(np.float32)
    HB=cv2.getPerspectiveTransform(uv,backquad)
    HF=cv2.getPerspectiveTransform(front_local.astype(np.float32),frontquad)
    bshade=1+.18*np.sin(np.deg2rad(angle))
    fshade=1-.085*(angle/90)
    composite_warp(img,back_rgba,HB,(*backquad.min(0),*backquad.max(0)),bshade)
    composite_warp(img,front_rgba,HF,(*frontquad.min(0),*frontquad.max(0)),fshade)
    # Sub-pixel paper thickness/light on ridge and rear exposed outside edge.
    cv2.line(img,tuple(np.round(xy[0]).astype(int)),tuple(np.round(xy[1]).astype(int)),(190,184,177),2,cv2.LINE_AA)
    # Motion softness is local rather than a global camera blur.
    return img

    yy,xx=np.mgrid[:size,:size]
    u=(xx-(size-1)/2)/((size-6)/2);v=(yy-(size-1)/2)/((size-6)/2)
    r2=u*u+v*v
    z=np.sqrt(np.maximum(0,1-r2))
    a=np.clip((1-np.sqrt(r2))*(size-6)/2+1,0,1)
    light=np.array([-.44,-.61,.66]);light/=np.linalg.norm(light)
    diffuse=np.maximum(0,u*light[0]+v*light[1]+z*light[2])
    illumination=.39+.68*diffuse
    rng=np.random.default_rng(43)
    fibers=rng.normal(0,1,(size,size))
    fine=cv2.GaussianBlur(fibers.astype(np.float32),(0,0),.45)
    rough=cv2.GaussianBlur(fibers.astype(np.float32),(0,0),2.7)
    col=np.zeros((size,size,3),np.float32)
    for c,base in enumerate([219,114,30]):

    # Seam mapped onto a wavy spherical equator, viewed obliquely.
    theta=np.linspace(0,2*np.pi,2800)
    lat=.62*np.sin(2*theta)
    pts=np.stack([np.cos(theta)*np.cos(lat),np.sin(theta)*np.cos(lat),np.sin(lat)],1)
    rr1=cv2.Rodrigues(np.array([.94,.78,-.45]))[0]
    pts=pts@rr1.T
    seam=np.zeros((size,size),np.uint8)
    for k in range(len(pts)-1):
        if pts[k,2]>.005 and pts[k+1,2]>.005:
            p1=np.round(pts[k,:2]*(size-6)/2+(size-1)/2).astype(int)
            p2=np.round(pts[k+1,:2]*(size-6)/2+(size-1)/2).astype(int)
            cv2.line(seam,tuple(p1),tuple(p2),255,4,cv2.LINE_AA)
    seam=cv2.GaussianBlur(seam.astype(np.float32)/255,(0,0),.65)
    border=cv2.GaussianBlur(seam,(0,0),1.6)
    col*=1-.15*border[:,:,None]
    seamcol=np.stack([198*illumination,184*illumination,136*illumination],2)
    col=col*(1-seam[:,:,None])+seamcol*seam[:,:,None]
    col=np.clip(col,0,255)
